name: SequenceGuard for WooCommerce
author: builtbyollie

sections.description:
SequenceGuard gives every new WooCommerce order a persistent sequential reference. It is designed for stores that need order references that are easy to quote, search, and reconcile.

  • Concurrency-safe sequence allocation
  • Automatic retry after temporary lock contention
  • Persistent order metadata
  • Order-list search support
  • HPOS and legacy order-storage compatibility
  • No external service, tracking, account, quota, or customer-data sync

SequenceGuard numbers new orders only. It never renumbers historic orders.

SequenceGuard Pro is an optional separate add-on. It adds custom prefixes, zero padding, and a local missing/duplicate-reference diagnostic. The free plugin remains fully functional without Pro.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload SequenceGuard under Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or install it from WordPress.org.
  3. Activate SequenceGuard.
  4. Open WooCommerce > SequenceGuard to confirm the current sequence.
sections.faq:
Does it change existing orders?

No. SequenceGuard assigns references only to orders created after activation.

Does it work with HPOS?

Yes. SequenceGuard declares HPOS compatibility and uses WooCommerce order APIs for order data.

What happens if I deactivate or uninstall it?

Existing order references remain stored with the orders. The sequence counter is retained so reinstalling the plugin cannot reuse an old reference.

Does it send data anywhere?

No. SequenceGuard works entirely on your WordPress site and does not contact an external service.
sections.changelog:
0.3.0

  • Prepared the standalone free edition for WordPress.org.
  • Added extension hooks for the separate Pro add-on.
  • Prevented duplicate Action Scheduler retry jobs.
  • Added deactivation cleanup while retaining order references and the counter.

0.2.0

  • Added a database-backed allocation lock with automatic retry after contention.
  • Runtime-tested sequential assignment, duplicate prevention, diagnostics, existing-order behaviour, and concurrent order creation with HPOS enabled and disabled.

0.1.0

  • First development build.
